sentences.text: Heard, learned Senior counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. This is an application filed by the petitioner praying for grant of anticipatory bail in terms of
Sections 482 and 484 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 apprehending his arrest for the
offences under Sections 406, 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, in connection with Bermo P.S.
Case No.60 of 2023, G.R. Case No.569 of 2023, pending in the Court of learned Sub-Divisional
Judicial Magistrate, Bermo at Tenughat.

entities.text:
Sub-Divisional
Judicial Magistrate, Bermo at Tenughat
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Admittedly, the offence punishable is up to seven years.
4.  Learned counsel for the State submits that notice under Section 35(3) of BNSS has been issued to the petitioner, but the petitioner till date has not responded.
5. Learned Senior counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner on instruction from the petitioner submits that till date his client has not received the notice under Section 35(3) of BNSS.
6. Be that as it may, since it has been submitted that the notice has been issued it will be presumed that the petitioner now has got the knowledge about the notice.
He should appear before the Investigating Officer and answer in terms of notice under Section 35(3) of BNSS.
